pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

banner_fus.desc: the banner: "CONGRATULATIONS FUSELLE" (half-painted); pivot at the middle of its top edge, under the door's lintel

banner_luigi.desc: the banner: "CONGRATULATIONS LUIGI"; pivot at the middle of its top edge, under the door's lintel

banner_luigi_fus.desc: the banner: "CONGRATULATIONS LUIGI & FUS"; pivot at the middle of its top edge, under the door's lintel

cage_back.desc: the far bars, a tone darker, behind the bride; pivot at the base's middle (0, 0)

cage_front.desc: the cage's near bars: ribs, a hoop, the base ring and a skull on the crown; pivot at the base's middle (0, 0)

sergeant_stripe.desc: Sergeant Bulkhead's stripe: a blue badge with three gold chevrons; pin it on the Bulky Bob-omb's body (front, upper left of its centre) at the 1.4x model's scale
